excluded_source_fields.MobileNo: personal phone number; kept only in the raw archive

block_id.description: SEC block ID; null for zila parishad seats.

panchayat_id.description: SEC panchayat ID; null for samiti and zila parishad seats.

seat_no.description: Ward, samiti or zila parishad seat number; null for mukhiya and sarpanch.

unit_id.description: Seat key within the office, built from the IDs.

district.description: District name from the portal frame.

block.description: Block name from the portal frame.

panchayat.description: Panchayat name from the portal frame.

phases_listed.description: Election rounds the portal lists for the seat, ';'-joined (e.g. 2021_1;2023_1); null when not requested.

result_records.description: Rows in the 2021 result feed; samiti and zila parishad seats have one row per candidate per panchayat.

result_only_candidates.description: Candidates named in results but missing from the candidate list.

winners_flagged.description: Candidates with IsWin true on any result row.

winner_flag_partial.description: IsWin differs across the winner's panchayat rows in the source.

in_candidate_list.description: Listed in the candidate list; false for candidates named only in results, whose list attributes are null.

candidate_serial.description: OrderBy in the candidate list (renumbered in name order); null if unlisted.

candidate_name.description: CandidateName, verbatim; the result-feed name without the winner mark when unlisted; null when blank in the source (one panch candidate).

symbol_file.description: SymbolUrl, the symbol image file name.

result_present.description: A result record was matched to this candidate.

result_serial.description: OrderBy of the matched result record.

match_method.description: How the result was matched; null without a result.

votes.description: TotalVote summed over the seat's result rows; null without results.

elected.description: IsWin from the result feed; null without results.

source_url.description: SEC request URL, including election phase and seat parameters.

fetched_at.description: UTC time the response was retrieved.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the saved response body.

source_row.description: One-based position of the record in that response.
